evidence_and_fallback.authority: User requested only previously pinned item facts if ISC msgbuf sources absent.
evidence_and_fallback.only_item_layout_fact: Eight opaque synthetic bytes: 11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88; no type, flags, request ID, opcode, endian fields, firmware format or firmware validity inferred.
evidence_and_fallback.provenance: New original code, using original frozen host fixture and fake ring as dependencies. No source implementation/comments/tables copied from ISC or GPL. No pcie-apple.c copy source.

api.bfi_encode: Exact8-byte independent output; short/oversize/null/owner-alias refused, failure preserves output.
api.bfi_check: Exact8-byte length and all8 bytes checked; read-only ring-slot inspection allowed.
api.bfi_submit: bfi_check first, then unchanged bcr_submit only. Ordinary preallocated fake buffer, index publication and fake BCM doorbell; no allocation, DMA or firmware image.
api.lifetime: Stable caller-owned ring/parent/accessor/buffers, caller serialization; no background callbacks, frees or hidden retry.
api.errors: BFI_SIZE -200, BFI_MISMATCH -201, BFI_UNSUPPORTED -202; existing BCR readiness/ring errors retained; default/KERNEL BFI_GATED100.
api.partial_failure: New guard read errors occur before ring admission and preserve ring/output. Once admitted, unchanged ring retains dirty/inflight/fault state after I/O or partial mutation, including a failed write that already applied.

gates.entry_guard: Genuine fake accessor binding; PHY reset clear/request+ACK ready, portRUN, linkUP/noBUSY/noL2, selected synthetic PCI14e4:4425, final PHY recheck.
gates.initial_down_reset: Each of encode/check/submit refuses before output, ring-buffer or register writes. The old ring retains its own per-access guards after validation.
gates.default_kernel: All3 item operations returnGATED without I/O or output changes. Host-compiled KERNEL tests are not SDK builds.
gates.no_drive: Shared APCIE PHY/PMGR writers compiled out; GPIO152/SMC compiled flags0; no T8103 MSI layout.

validation.mutation_rule: Baseline must compile/run first. Every counted mutant compiles and then fails an assertion; compile failures are not counted.
validation.fixture_scope: Healthy predecessor fake setup/configuration runs before new-operation measurement. Its prior writes are not presented as whole-boot zero-write proof. The old test main is renamed but never run; old receipt/tests not regenerated.
validation.repository_checks: Only bounded new host suite run. No repository-wide, SDK, kernel-link or hardware test claimed.

actual_hardware_scope: The real saved read-only PCIe observation remains PHY_NOT_READY. No actual RC/port/ECAM/chip/BAR/DMA/firmware-load fact follows from this host fixture.
stop_boundary: One source/host receipt only; no boot packet or hardware admission.
